# Check A01-tunnel183 on a phone

1. Install the next APK; Tatakikun as the keyboard; open any text field.
2. Hold `a`: the popup shows `@` (半角) and `＠` (全角), the half-width one highlighted. Lift: `@` is typed.
3. Hold `a` again, slide right onto `＠`, lift: `＠` is typed.
4. Type `nihao`, Space (你好), then hold `。` and lift on `?`: a half-width `?` is typed, not `？`.
5. Hold `,`: only `、` is offered.
